func TestEngine_Namespaces(t *testing.T) {
 ctx := context.Background()
 policy := "'`package flipt.authz.v1
import rego.v1
viewable_namespaces contains ns if {
 some role in input.authentication.roles
 role == "devs"
 ns := ["local", "staging"][_]
}
viewable_namespaces contains ns if {
 some role in input.authentication.roles
 role == "ops"
 ns := "production"
}`
 server := sdktest.MustNewServer(sdktest.MockBundle("/bundles/bundle.tar.gz", map[string]string{"main.rego": policy}))
 defer server.Stop()
 config := fmt.Sprintf(`{"services":{"test":{"url":%q}},"bundles":{"test":{"resource":"/bundles/bundle.tar.gz"}}}`, server.URL())
 opa, err := sdk.New(ctx, sdk.Options{Config: strings.NewReader(config), Store: inmem.New(), Logger: ozap.Wrap(zaptest.NewLogger(t), &zap.AtomicLevel{})})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 engine := &Engine{opa: opa, logger: zaptest.NewLogger(t)}
 defer engine.Shutdown(ctx)
 for _, tc := range []struct { roles []string; want []string }{
  {nil, []string{}},
  {[]string{"devs"}, []string{"local", "staging"}},
  {[]string{"ops"}, []string{"production"}},
  {[]string{"devs", "ops"}, []string{"local", "production", "staging"}},
 } {
  got, err := engine.Namespaces(ctx, map[string]any{"authentication": map[string]any{"roles": tc.roles}})
  require.NoError(t, err)
  require.Equal(t, tc.want, got)
 }
}
EOF

func TestEngine_NamespacesUndefined(t *testing.T) {
 ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
 defer cancel()
 engine, err := newEngine(ctx, zaptest.NewLogger(t), withPolicySource(policySource("'`package flipt.authz.v1
import rego.v1
default allow := false`)))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 _, err = engine.Namespaces(ctx, nil)
 require.ErrorContains(t, err, "undefined")
}

func TestEngine_NamespacesMalformed(t *testing.T) {
 ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
 defer cancel()
 engine, err := newEngine(ctx, zaptest.NewLogger(t), withPolicySource(policySource(`package flipt.authz.v1
import rego.v1
default allow := false
viewable_namespaces := ["local", 12]`)))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 _, err = engine.Namespaces(ctx, nil)
 require.ErrorContains(t, err, "invalid viewable namespace")
}
